newsitem.title: ITALY: Olivetti - no Infostrada financing operation.
newsitem.headline: Olivetti - no Infostrada financing operation.

text.p: Italian information technology group Olivetti on Monday repeated its denial that it planned any financing operation for its Infostrada telecoms joint venture with France Telecom.
Olivetti had already on Friday denied market and press talk that was planning a capital increase.
Olivetti and France Telecom earlier this month signed a deal under which the French group would acquire 49 percent of Infostrada by subscribing to a 165 billion capital increase.

The balance of Infostrada will be held by Olivetti and Bell Atlantic through a newly created holding company, Infoinvestment. The deal also foresees the possibility of France Telecom partners Deutsche Telekom and Sprint entering Infostrada.

Olivetti said in a statement that it considered that financial means for the development of Infostrada "can be found on the market and it will not have to carry out any specific financing operation for its own stake in Infostrada."
Olivetti said it was making the statement on the request of Bourse supervisory authority Consob.
